key_points: Qualcomm stock declined 1.8‑7% over the last few sessions amid profit‑taking, insider selling and a broader tech selloff.
Analyst pieces note handset revenue headwinds and valuation cheap relative to Broadcom, but warn of customer concentration and SBC load.
Mobile AI advancements (Snapdragon agentic computing) are highlighted as a growth catalyst, yet profitability from on‑device AI remains unproven.
Recent downgrades and cautious commentary (Seeking Alpha, deteriorating handset moat) add to near‑term skepticism.
No earnings surprises, guidance changes, M&A or regulatory news; most headlines are generic market commentary.
